'''Naga Sadow's Mothership''' was a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] that the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] used as a flagship during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the sphere was destroyed when Sadow made [[Primus Goluud/Legends|Primus Goluud]] go [[Supernova (Sith magic)|supernova]] during the [[Battle at Primus Goluud]].<ref name="fall4" />
